remote_command:
date -Is
uname -a
cat /etc/nv_tegra_release
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime
lspci -nnk | grep -A 4 -i network
ip -br addr
iw dev wlP1p1s0 link
iw dev wlP1p1s0 info
iw dev wlP1p1s0 get power_save
nmcli -t -f NAME,TYPE,DEVICE connection show --active
for module in iwlwifi iwlmvm cfg80211 mac80211; do modinfo -F filename "$module"; modinfo -F vermagic "$module"; sha256sum "$(modinfo -n "$module")"; done
sha256sum /lib/firmware/iwlwifi-ty-a0-gf-a0-66.ucode /lib/firmware/iwlwifi-ty-a0-gf-a0.pnvm
cd /home/taeholee/Rover
find rover -maxdepth 1 -name '*.py' -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum
ls /dev/video* 2>/dev/null || true
lsusb
